🚀 We're Hiring: Digital Marketing Executive (Social Media & SEO) — 2 Positions
📍 Location: Ashram Road, Ahmedabad (On-site)
At Ziya HealthTech, we're building a next-generation mental healthcare ecosystem that combines wellness, clinical care, and AI-driven support.
If you're passionate about content, SEO, and organic growth, this is your opportunity to contribute to a meaningful product at an early-stage startup.
• Plan and execute organic social media strategies across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
• Develop content calendars and coordinate engaging Reels, carousels, posts, and other content formats.
• Conduct keyword research and implement on-page SEO strategies to improve website visibility.
• Optimize website content, metadata, headings, and internal linking.
• Identify opportunities to increase organic traffic, search rankings, engagement, and conversions.
• Research competitors, content trends, and niche influencer collaborations.
• Monitor performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and social media analytics tools.
• Contribute to app visibility through basic App Store Optimization (ASO).
• Experience: 6 months to 2 years only in digital marketing, social media marketing, or SEO.
• Candidates with more than 3 years of professional experience are not eligible for this position.
• Practical understanding of organic social media growth and content marketing.
• Basic knowledge of keyword research, on-page SEO, and website optimization.
• Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, or similar tools.
• Understanding of digital marketing metrics, including engagement, CTR, organic traffic, and conversions.
• Comfortable using ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar AI tools for research and productivity.
• Creative, analytical, self-driven, and willing to take ownership.
• Work on a meaningful product in mental healthcare.
• Take ownership and learn in a fast-growing startup environment.
• Contribute directly to the company's organic growth strategy.
• Work with a team that values creativity, initiative, and continuous learning.
💰 Compensation: As per industry standards and experience.
Send your resume and, preferably, examples of your previous work or portfolio.
Join Ziya and help us make mental well-being more accessible.
